observations: Photo 0 shows a black product box with text: 'LEGEND STUDIO SEMI-OPEN COMFORT HANDCRAFTED', and a website 'Audiomaxng.com'. The box features an image of over-ear headphones with a silver driver and black headband. The text 'DT 880 PRO' is visible vertically on the right side of the box.
Photo 1 shows a close-up of over-ear headphones with a silver driver, black headband, and grey ear cushions. The brand 'beyerdynamic' is visible on the side of the headband, along with its logo.
The headphones in photo 1 match the image on the box in photo 0.
The seller claims 'DT 880 PRO' and '250 ohms impedance for studio use'.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 box text and photo 1 headband both show 'DT 880 PRO' and 'beyerdynamic' branding.

claims.claim: Studio headphones for mixing and mastering (semi-open)
claims.evidence: Photo 0 box text says 'LEGEND STUDIO SEMI-OPEN', and photo 1 shows the semi-open driver design.
The impedance is not visible in the photos. The seller's claim cannot be confirmed or denied from the images alone.

risks.risk: The headphones may not be genuine or may be a counterfeit product.
risks.proof: A clear shot of the product's serial number, packaging details, and a close-up of the driver with model engraving.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a counterfeit or lower-tier model, which would significantly reduce value.

risks.risk: The impedance may not be 250 ohms as claimed, which affects compatibility and performance.
risks.proof: A close-up of the product label or manual showing the impedance specification.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as unknown impedance, which may be lower (e.g., 80 ohms) and less suitable for studio use, reducing value.

risks.risk: The headphones may be used or damaged, not new as implied by the box.
risks.proof: A full view of the headphones with the cable, ear pads, and headband showing wear, and a shot of the inside of the box for signs of use.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used or possibly damaged, which reduces value.

proof_requests: A clear close-up of the product label or manual showing the impedance (250 ohms).
A full view of the headphones showing the cable, ear pads, and headband for signs of wear.
A shot of the inside of the box and any included accessories or documentation.
A close-up of the serial number or model engraving on the driver or headband.
response.reason: The brand and model are identifiable, but critical claims like impedance and condition cannot be verified from the photos. The risk of counterfeit or used condition affects pricing, so proof is needed before pricing.
